content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a memory leak that occurred when the function `tipc_nl_node_get_link()` failed to free the `nlmsg` (netlink message) when `tipc_node_find_by_name()` returned NULL. This failure to release allocated memory led to a memory leak, as the allocated `skb` (socket buffer) was not properly freed in the event of an error. The patch addresses this by introducing a `goto` label to ensure that the `nlmsg_free(msg.skb)` is called in all error cases, thus preventing the memory leak.
